column1: # Runtime voice: radio chats between kerbals of two vessels nearby: a ship and a kerbal outside, a ship and a
# lander, two EVA kerbals further apart. The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv.
# A chat with apart=1 in the when of line 1 only plays between two kerbals of different vessels within 2.3 km. It
# sounds like the radio and needs no link to Mission Control. Line 1 has the values of the kerbal who starts it:
# a_eva is 1 when that kerbal is on EVA (else 0), b_eva the same for the other. pair_m is the meters between the
# two vessels, jet and ship_m are the starter's own on EVA. my_ship is the ship the speaker is in, their_ship the
# ship of the one spoken to (not set for a kerbal on EVA). link is 1 with a link to Mission Control, else 0.
# Each wording of a line must fit each wording of the line before and after it: the wordings are picked one by one.

column4: spanish
column5: english

column4: {other}, ¿qué tal ahí fuera? | {other}, ¿cómo va el paseo?
column5: {other}, how's it out there? | {other}, how's the walk?

column4: Precioso. Deberías salir. | Bien. El traje aprieta un poco.
column5: Gorgeous. You should come out. | Fine. The suit's a bit tight.

column4: Aquí dentro tenemos café. | Pues aquí dentro se está calentito.
column5: We have coffee in here. | Well, it's nice and warm in here.

column4: {other}, te veo por la ventana. | {other}, te estoy viendo por la ventanilla.
column5: {other}, I can see you through the window. | {other}, I'm watching you through the porthole.

column4: Hola. Estoy saludando. | ¿Me ves? Estoy haciendo el pino.
column5: Hi. I'm waving. | Can you see me? I'm doing a handstand.

column4: Ya. Parece que te estás ahogando. | Muy bonito. Ahora vuelve dentro.
column5: Yeah. It looks like you're drowning. | Very nice. Now come back in.

column4: {other}, estás a {pair_m} metros de la nave. | {other}, ya vas por {pair_m} metros.
column5: {other}, you're {pair_m} meters from the ship. | {other}, that's {pair_m} meters already.

column4: Solo voy a mirar una cosa. | Lo sé. Desde aquí la nave parece de juguete.
column5: Just checking something. | I know. The ship looks like a toy from here.

column4: Vale. Pero vuelve antes de que oscurezca. | Vale. No traigas nada raro.
column5: Okay. But be back before dark. | Okay. Don't bring anything weird back.

column4: {other}, llevas {eva_mins} minutos fuera. | {other}, ¿piensas volver algún día?
column5: {other}, you've been out {eva_mins} minutes. | {other}, are you ever coming back?

column4: Cinco minutos más. | Cuando se me acabe el aire. Es broma.
column5: Five more minutes. | When I run out of air. Just kidding.

column4: Eso dijiste hace un rato. | Muy gracioso. Te guardo la cena.
column5: You said that a while ago. | Very funny. I'll save you dinner.

column4: {other}, me queda el {jet} por ciento de propulsor. | {other}, aviso: mochila al {jet} por ciento.
column5: {other}, I have {jet} percent propellant left. | {other}, heads up: jetpack at {jet} percent.

column4: Pues vuelve antes de que se acabe. | Recibido. Dejo la escotilla abierta.
column5: Then come back before it runs out. | Copy. I'll leave the hatch open.

column4: Voy. Despacito. | Gracias. Ya voy.
column5: On my way. Slowly. | Thanks. Coming.

column4: {other}, ¿qué haces ahí dentro? | {other}, ¿me echas de menos?
column5: {other}, what are you doing in there? | {other}, do you miss me?

column4: Mirar botones. Muy emocionante. | Nada. Comerme tu postre.
column5: Looking at buttons. Very exciting. | Nothing. Eating your dessert.

column4: Qué envidia. Aquí fuera no hay nada que hacer. | Pues yo tengo mejores vistas.
column5: So jealous. There's nothing to do out here. | Well, I have the better view.

column4: {other}, ¿qué tal {their_ship} desde dentro? | {other}, desde aquí la nave se ve muy pequeña.
column5: {other}, how's {their_ship} from the inside? | {other}, the ship looks really small from here.

column4: Igual que siempre. Huele a calcetín. | No digas eso. Te está oyendo.
column5: Same as always. Smells like socks. | Don't say that. It can hear you.

column4: Ya me acuerdo. Me quedo fuera un rato más. | Perdón. Es muy bonita. Muy grande.
column5: Now I remember. I'll stay out a bit longer. | Sorry. It's very pretty. Very big.

column4: {their_ship}, aquí {my_ship}. ¿Me recibes? | {other}, ¿me oyes desde ahí?
column5: {their_ship}, this is {my_ship}. Do you copy? | {other}, can you hear me over there?

column4: Alto y claro. Te veo por la ventana. | Te oigo. Estás muy cerca, por cierto.
column5: Loud and clear. I can see you out the window. | I hear you. You're very close, by the way.

column4: Bien. Ni se te ocurra chocar. | Perfecto. Mantén la distancia.
column5: Good. Don't you dare bump into us. | Perfect. Keep your distance.

column4: {other}, ¿qué tal la nave pequeña? | {other}, ¿cómo va todo en {their_ship}?
column5: {other}, how's the little ship? | {other}, how's everything on {their_ship}?

column4: Pequeña pero mía. | Estrecha. Pero tiene ventana.
column5: Small but mine. | Cramped. But it has a window.

column4: Cuídala. La necesitamos entera. | Pues disfruta. Nos vemos a la vuelta.
column5: Take care of it. We need it in one piece. | Enjoy it, then. See you when you're back.

column4: {other}, te tengo a {pair_m} metros. | {other}, estás a {pair_m} metros de nosotros.
column5: {other}, I have you at {pair_m} meters. | {other}, you're {pair_m} meters from us.

column4: Recibido. Todo en orden aquí. | Lo sé. Te saludo desde aquí.
column5: Copy. All good here. | I know. Waving at you from here.

column4: Bien. Seguimos en contacto. | Te veo. Más o menos.
column5: Good. Stay in touch. | I see you. More or less.

column4: {other}, ¿qué tal el suelo de {here}? | {other}, ¿cómo se está ahí abajo?
column5: {other}, how's the ground on {here}? | {other}, how is it down there?

column4: Firme. Más o menos. | Todo bien. No se mueve nada. Casi nada.
column5: Solid. More or less. | All good. Nothing's moving. Almost nothing.

column4: Me alegro. Yo sigo aquí, mirando. | Bien. Avísame si algo se mueve.
column5: Glad to hear. I'm still here, watching. | Good. Tell me if anything moves.

column4: {other}, prueba de radio. | {other}, ¿sigues ahí?
column5: {other}, radio check. | {other}, are you still there?

column4: Aquí sigo. Te oigo bien. | Te recibo. ¿Qué pasa?
column5: Still here. I hear you fine. | I copy. What's up?

column4: Nada. Solo quería oír una voz. | Nada. Comprobaba que no te habías ido.
column5: Nothing. I just wanted to hear a voice. | Nothing. Checking you hadn't left.

column4: {other}, el centro espacial no contesta. | {other}, no tenemos señal con casa.
column5: {other}, KSC isn't answering. | {other}, we have no signal home.

column4: Pues hablamos entre nosotros. | Mejor. Así nadie nos manda nada.
column5: Then we talk among ourselves. | Better. Nobody can tell us what to do.

column4: Vale. ¿Tú qué tal? | Me gusta cómo piensas.
column5: Okay. How are you doing? | I like how you think.

column4: {other}, sin casa en la radio esto está muy tranquilo. | {other}, ¿te has dado cuenta? Nadie nos dice qué hacer.
column5: {other}, with no home on the radio it's very quiet. | {other}, have you noticed? Nobody's telling us what to do.

column4: Demasiado tranquilo. | Lo sé. Es un poco raro.
column5: Too quiet. | I know. It's a bit strange.

column4: Pues te cuento un chiste. | Disfrútalo mientras dure.
column5: Then I'll tell you a joke. | Enjoy it while it lasts.

column4: {other}, voy a acercarme un poco más. | {other}, ¿y si nos acercamos un poco?
column5: {other}, I'm going to get a bit closer. | {other}, what if we get a little closer?

column4: ¿Más? Ya estamos bastante cerca. | Por favor, no. Así está perfecto.
column5: Closer? We're close enough already. | Please don't. This is perfect.

column4: Tranquilidad. Tengo un plan. | Vale, vale. Me quedo aquí.
column5: Relax. I have a plan. | Okay, okay. I'll stay here.
